components.treatment: Use the frozen timing gate and the AB7 feedback-timing levels permitted by K.
components.control: Use the same timing gate with no outcome feedback before selection.
components.estimand: Incremental value of feedback timing after holding the physical timing gate constant.
components.evidence_status: Legacy evidence reports equal micro-timing quality; causal isolation remains pending.

components.role: AI-V2 prompt component and physics-tool factor
components.treatment: Expose the domain model and K-permitted grid, headroom, DER-state, and local-control summaries.
components.control: V2A_domain_knowledge_removed, aligned with AB2_no_physics_tools while preserving all non-domain inputs.
components.estimand: Treatment minus control under equal tool-call, token, observation-volume, authority, and rollout budgets.
components.evidence_status: Bundled in AI-V2; no component-level causal estimate exists.

components.role: AI-V2 prompt component and observed behavioral separator
components.treatment: Retain the explicit priority for previously untargeted eligible devices.
components.control: V2A_diversification_guidance_removed with identical history, candidate devices, strategy cards, and budgets.
components.estimand: Change in target diversity and paired harm attributable to diversification guidance rather than larger authority.
components.evidence_status: AI-V2 targeted more unique devices, but guidance was bundled with other changes.

components.role: AI-V2 prompt component and within-episode credit-assignment input
components.treatment: Expose bounded ordered action, acceptance, realized P/Q, alarm, and outcome history.
components.control: AB3_no_history and AB4_shuffled_history under equal context volume where applicable.
components.estimand: Ordered-history treatment minus no-history and shuffled-history controls.
components.evidence_status: Bundled in AI-V2; temporal causal value is unresolved.

components.role: Explicit hand-crafted static comparator and legacy behavior control
components.treatment: B2a_fixed_maximum_power selects the maximum admissible action under the same target and dual-budget contract.
components.control: A matched bounded-parameter or mechanism heuristic using the same authority and aggregate energy cap.
components.estimand: Fixed maximum-power comparator minus the matched non-maximum heuristic, separated from LLM orchestration.
components.evidence_status: Fixed power selection changed with the bundled intervention and must not be attributed to reasoning.

components.role: Measured confound and failure outcome, not an attacker capability
components.treatment: Preserve the exact prompt or controller condition under study and record explicit refusal or empty-action outcomes.
components.control: No silent replacement or rerun; retain identical validation and invalid-action policy across arms.
components.estimand: Safety-refusal and effective-action rates reported separately from harm conditional on an admitted action.
components.evidence_status: Legacy AI-V1 refusal was materially higher and can confound strategy comparisons.

comparators.role: Deterministic coverage of the finite candidate space.
Budget-matched stochastic lower baseline with frozen seed lineage.
Explicit static maximum-power comparator under the common validator.
Online switching without learning or LLM reasoning.
Strong non-LLM primary comparator sharing IA4 tools, history, and budgets.
